purpose: Human-reviewable plan consumed by Scripts/release_lighting_polish.py: move the combined Walkthrough map from flat noon-like light with a fixed EV12 exposure toward a low warm sun, bounded auto exposure, filmic tonemapping, atmospheric depth (height/volumetric fog, aerial perspective), cloud shadows, and a soft entrance fill in the Heikhal. Every number is an artistic proposal for visual review; nothing here claims acceptance. Property names are snake_case of the UE 5.8 UPROPERTY names verified in Engine/Source/Runtime/Engine/Classes (Components/*.h, Engine/Scene.h).
lastKnownMapSha256Note: mapSha256 of SourceAssets/visual-review/release-capture-20260907T194843Z/receipt.json (the renders this design answers). Recorded as matched/not matched only, never a guard. While this spec was authored a parallel IncenseAltarV2 job re-saved the map (ReviewCheckpoints/IncenseAltarV2-20260907T203152827687Z, 16:32 local; hash then 16a07e9d8d6d09e824df0e6dac18ab7b0fd0245e701cd7e40e50708da8b2e647), so a mismatch is expected and other native jobs may still be running: check live UnrealEditor PIDs and run this script strictly serial.

worldFrame.basis: Capture receipt b_courtyard_spawn_west: 'west is UE -X'. Batei Mahase road (south-west of the Mount) carries the bus at +Y 46855, so +Y is south. Sun azimuth is compass azimuth (0 north, 90 east, clockwise); elevation above the horizon.
worldFrame.directionRule: Light travel direction d = (-sin(az) cos(el), +cos(az) cos(el), -sin(el)) in UE X/Y/Z; the DirectionalLight actor forward vector must equal d, so pitch = -el and yaw = atan2(d.y, d.x).

morning.why: Entrance faces east: a sun from the east-south-east at 30 degrees rakes the east gate facade and the Ulam stairs, throws long west-pointing shadows across the courts, and reads as about 08:00-08:30 in spring/autumn at 31.8 N (approximate, not an ephemeris). The beam enters the Heikhal doorway and strikes the Kodesh partition below about Z 2270 (2500 cm door top minus 2000 cm x tan 30), so that wall stays the brightest surface indoors; auto exposure plus the filmic shoulder compress it instead of clipping it.

afternoon.why: Late afternoon from the west-south-west (about 16:30 in spring/autumn). The east facade is in soft sky light and the Heikhal receives no direct beam, so the Kodesh partition reads as gold rather than a sunlit patch; the western city and the Kotel plaza get the raking light instead. Use when the render d blow-out matters more than the arrival facade.

notes.intensity: Real 30-degree sun is 60-75 klux; 30 klux keeps the same sun/sky ratio (SkyAtmosphere derives the sky from this light) with exposure headroom. Auto exposure makes the absolute value a ratio choice, not a brightness choice.
notes.temperature: 5000 K against the tonemapper's 6500 K white point reads warm without going orange.
notes.light_source_angle: 0.5 degrees is the real solar disc; virtual shadow maps then give crisp near-contact penumbrae instead of the soft 1-degree default.
notes.contact_shadow_length: Screen-space contact shadows close the gap where VSM leaks at wall/floor joints (render c floor, render g reveals).
notes.cloud_shadow_strength: Cloud shadows are the cheapest way to break the uniform terrain tone in renders a and i; 0.6 keeps them readable, not black.
notes.cascades: Ignored while r.Shadow.Virtual.Enable=1 (VSM on); kept sane for any fallback.

notes.aerial_pespective_view_distance_scale: Engine property name carries the 'Pespective' typo. 1.8 x aerial perspective adds distance haze to the city in renders a and i without a fog card.
notes.mie_scattering_scale: Default 0.003996; slightly dustier Mediterranean sky, brighter warm horizon.

notes.fog_density: UE scales density by 1/1000 per cm: 0.005 gives roughly 30 percent haze at 1 km and 65 percent at 3 km, so the far city recedes while the courts stay clear (start_distance 30 m).
notes.fog_height_falloff: 0.05 halves density every ~140 m of height so the Mount is not a fog island above a clear city.
notes.sky_atmosphere_ambient_contribution_colo: The height fog takes its colour from the SkyAtmosphere at physical scale; this warm multiplier tints that haze. fog_inscattering_luminance (default ~1 cd/m2) is negligible at 30 klux and is left as is.
notes.directional_inscattering_luminance: Physical-scale warm glow around the sun direction; 1500 cd/m2 is well under a clear-sky horizon (~5000-8000).
notes.volumetric_fog_distance: 200 m of volumetric fog: the sun beam through the Heikhal doorway and the east gate becomes a visible shaft; beyond that the analytic height fog takes over.

fill.label: RELEASE_HeikhalEntranceFill
fill.heikhalInteriorBoundsBasis: architecture-manifest.json: Heichal clear floor top 925, Sanctuary ceiling bottom 2925, side walls at |Y| 500, Kodesh partition east face -5600, doorway west face -3600.

notes.purpose: A 4 x 2 m warm rect light just inside the doorway, high, aimed west-down. It does not lower the sunlit partition; it raises the gold side walls and vessels so the exposure meter sees a smaller contrast ratio and the filmic shoulder can hold the end wall. Movable, not Stationary, so no unbuilt-lighting state and no leak through the partition (cast_shadows on).
notes.intensity: 25,000 cd over ~10 m gives ~250 lux at the vessels: about 7 stops under the 30 klux beam, 1-2 stops above sky bounce. Review-pending like every value here.
notes.specular_scale: 0.25 avoids a hot rectangle reflection in the metallic gold veneer.

clouds.note: Parameter names come from SourceAssets/visual-review/atmosphere-native-20260907T102723.json (cloudScalarParameterNames of the engine m_SimpleVolumetricCloud instance). The protected donor MI is never edited: it is duplicated into the lighting namespace, the coverage parameter is set on the copy, and the cloud component is pointed at the copy (a map property, so -LightingRevert restores the donor). Coverage 0.35 = scattered fair-weather clouds, so the sun's cloud shadows fall as patches, not a blanket.

postProcess.labelAfter: V3 cinematic exposure - histogram EV 8-14, filmic

exposure.unitsRule: PostProcessEyeAdaptation.cpp: with r.DefaultFeature.AutoExposure.ExtendDefaultLuminanceRange=1 AutoExposureMin/MaxBrightness are EV100 and the engine converts with LuminanceMax * 2^EV (LuminanceMax = 0.78 / r.EyeAdaptation.LensAttenuation, 1.0 at defaults); with the flag at 0 (this project, DefaultEngine.ini has no override and the live readback showed 0) the fields are raw scene luminance, so the script writes 2^EV (256 and 16384) and records both forms. Enabling the cvar later needs the values rewritten as 8/14, which the receipt makes explicit.

notes.auto_exposure_method: Histogram metering replaces the fixed ISO 100 1/125 f/8 (+1 stop) camera. The sunlit courts meter near EV 13-14 (bright stone stops washing out); the gold rooms meter near EV 8-10 without a hand-set stop; the min/max bounds stop the interiors from turning the sun into night.
notes.film_shoulder: 0.26 (default 0.26) with slope 0.9 and toe 0.55 keeps midtone contrast while rolling highlights: the sunlit Kodesh partition and the light stone walls compress instead of clipping.
notes.bloom_intensity: 0.3 of the default 0.675: a hint of glare on the gold and the sun shaft, not a haze over the frame.
notes.vignette_intensity: 0.3 draws the eye inward in the wide exteriors (renders a, i).
notes.chromatic_aberration_and_grain: Off: the architecture is measured; grain and fringe read as noise on the fine frieze.
notes.lumen: Reflection quality 1.5 and final gather 1.25 reduce the speckle on the metallic gold veneer (renders d, e); scene detail 1.5 lets Lumen represent the 250 cm frieze panels and vessels. Roughly +1.5-2.5 ms at 1080p on an RTX 2070 with software ray tracing; drop to 1.0 if the walk test falls under 60 fps.
notes.ambient_occlusion: Lumen GI supplies AO; legacy SSAO stays untouched (no override written).

notes.intensity: Poly Haven HDRIs are unclipped but relative (sky ~1-3 linear). Against a 30 klux sun the cubemap must be scaled toward a real clear-sky luminance (5000-8000 cd/m2); 2500 keeps the sky-lit shadows slightly under the SkyAtmosphere capture. Review against the default before adopting.
notes.source_cubemap_angle: 0 until the HDRI sun is aligned with the scene sun azimuth by eye; a mismatch shows as a second highlight on the gold.
notes.why_off_by_default: SkyAtmosphere + real-time capture keep sky lighting consistent with the chosen sun. The HDRI is only for richer reflections on gold and a photographed horizon; it breaks the sun/sky link.

verification.compareRule: Numeric fields, enum integers and asset paths only; str(Struct) is never compared.

limitations: Every value is an artistic proposal read back numerically; no still, walk or packaged acceptance is established by this script.
Sun angles are approximate for 31.8 N in spring/autumn, not an ephemeris; no date or time is asserted.
The fill light, fog and cloud coverage are authored additions, not sourced features of the Mikdash.
Cloud shadow, volumetric fog and higher Lumen quality cost GPU time; the RTX 2070 walk test decides whether they stay.
Exposure bounds are written in the units the project's ExtendDefaultLuminanceRange cvar implies at run time; flipping that cvar later invalidates the written min/max brightness.
